Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: several terrorist elements neutralized in the Ouagadou Forest
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 21, 2026 (AMAP) - The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, have successfully carried out an action against a group of motorcyclists in the Ouagadou forest, near the village of Ngoma Koura, the General Staff of the Armed Forces announced in a statement released Wednesday. According to the press release, this operation is part of the ongoing surveillance, control and security of the national territory carried out as part of Operation Dougoukoloko.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Germany: Students call for protest on October 31, police fear excesses
Mali.summary: Bamako, October 21 (AMAP) The student collective "Gen Z steht auf" called for national demonstrations on October 31 in Germany to denounce cuts in spending on education and social services, the rising cost of living and plans to restore compulsory military service, reports the Anadolu Agency . Gatherings are planned in Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Frankfurt, Munich and other cities across the country.

Mali.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: several fighters neutralized in the Ouagadou forest
Mali.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: several neutralized fighters in the forest of Ouagadou On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) struck a group of motorcyclists spotted in the forest of Ouagadou, near the village of Ngoma Koura. According to the General Staff of the Armed Forces, several terrorist elements were neutralized during this operation . This action is part of Operation Dougoukoloko, conducted to strengthen the surveillance and security of the national territory.

Mali.title: Massacre in Mali: Islamic State militants kill at least 48 civilians in Ménaka
Mali.summary: The Idaksahak pastoralist community was targeted in an apparent revenge attack following military operations, raising fears of further bloodshed in northeastern Mali.

Mali.title: Benbere platform fights disinformation in Mali
Mali.summary: It is increasingly difficult for young people, in the Sahel countries as elsewhere, to distinguish between information and disinformation. Young people are really at the heart of the dynamics of fake news because they are, first of all, the main target, on social networks that have become the main source of information for adolescents and young adults But young people are also key players in the fight against disinformation.

Mali.title: Ouagadou Forest: The FAMa neutralize a major terrorist column
Mali.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national opinion that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing the permanent operations of surveillance, control and security of the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko . On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the use of precise information made it possible to detect and follow several columns of motorcyclists moving in the Ouagadou forest, near the village of Ngoma Koura.

Mali.title: Mali: About forty civilians killed Sunday by armed men in the Ménaka region
Mali.summary: In Mali, the Executive Office of the Idaksahak community expressed on Monday "its strong emotion and its immense dismay" after the death of 48 civilians of the community, last Sunday, on the side of Tagadayat, in the region of Menaka. According to their statement, "these defenceless civilian populations were attacked by armed elements of Daesh [Islamic State group, editor's note], arrived on board several motorcycles" .

Mali.title: Mali : 69 militaires comparaissent devant la justice militaire, plusieurs crimes leur sont reprochés
Mali.summary: Le Tribunal militaire de Mopti examine, depuis le lundi 19 octobre 2026 à Sévaré, 43 dossiers impliquant 72 prévenus, dont 69 militaires. La justice militaire malienne examine plusieurs affaires aux enjeux différents. Ouverte le lundi 19 octobre à Sévaré, dans le centre du Mali, la session correctionnelle et criminelle du Tribunal militaire de Mopti doit se poursuivre jusqu’au 29 octobre.

Mali.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
Mali.title: Kenya: Paul Mackenzie and 28 other defendants convicted for the murder of 192 children and one adult
Mali.summary: Bamako, Oct 21 (AMAP) A Kenyan court on Monday found Pastor Paul Mackenzie and 28 other defendants guilty of the murder of 192 children and an adult in the Shakahola massacre, a tragedy that killed more than 400 people, according to Kenyan authorities “I am satisfied that the prosecution has proved the facts against the 29 defendants for the murder of 192 children and one adult in accordance with section 203 of the Criminal Code,” said High Court Judge Diana Kavedza-Mochache when the verdict was delivered.

Mali.title: Image Publié le 21 octobre 2026 Afrique Burkina Faso: la peine de mort rétablie par le gouvernement militaire d'Ibrahim Traoré huit ans après son abolition Le Burkina Faso a rétabli, mardi 21 octobre, la peine de mort, abolie en 2018, dans un nouveau Code pénal, voté à l'unanimité par les 71 membres non…
Mali.summary: Le Burkina Faso a rétabli, mardi 21 octobre, la peine de mort, abolie en 2018, dans un nouveau Code pénal, voté à l'unanimité par les 71 membres non élus de l'Assemblée législative du peuple. Le texte durcit aussi les peines pour de nombreux délits. Image d'archives du capitaine Ibrahim Traoré, au deuxième sommet de l'Alliance des États du Sahel (AES) sur la sécurité et le développement à Bamako, au Mali, le mardi 23 décembre 2025.

Mali.title: MALI: 724 NEW RECRUITS UNDER THE FLAG AT SÉNOU AIR BASE 101, THE 2025 CONTINGENT READY TO PROTECT THE NATION
Mali.summary: The commitment and moral rearmament of the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) has reached a new milestone. This Monday, October 19, 2026, the Training Center of the Senou Air Base 101 served as a framework for a solemn takeover marking the end of the Basic Common Training (FCB) for 724 young recruits of the 2025 contingent. A symbolic event of renewal, bravery and dedication to the Fatherland .

Burkina Faso.title: Forum: "Families of victims of crimes, we ask for the lifting of defence secrecy"
Burkina Faso.summary: Below, a Tribune of victims and members of the secret defense collective, of which the International Network, Justice for Thomas Sankara and his companions is a member. This op-ed is in particular signed by Mariam Sankara, Aïda Kiemdé and Céline Bamouni, respectively daughter of Frédéric Kiemdé and Paulin Bamouni, murdered alongside Thomas Sankara on 15 October 1987 in Ouagadougou .

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: the new Penal Code provides for the reinstatement of the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: On Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the People's Legislative Assembly adopted a new Penal Code in Burkina Faso. The text provides for the reinstatement of the death penalty for certain offences, including terrorism, treason, espionage and parricide. The import of expired or prohibited products resulting in death is also concerned.

Burkina Faso.title: Ten suspects arrested in an alleged QNET case
Burkina Faso.summary: The Sangalkam Territorial Brigade arrested ten foreign nationals on Monday, October 19, 2026, in Kounoune Centrale, Senegal, following information indicating the presumed presence of a network linked to QNET. Investigations continue to determine the scope of this network's activities and establish the responsibilities of the defendants The operation carried out by the Sangalkam Territorial Brigade led to the arrest of ten individuals of different nationalities.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso - The ruling junta reinstates the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: - Burkina Faso: La junte au pouvoir rétablit la peine de mort RFI, 21 Octobre 2026 les 71 députés burkinabè ont adopté à l'unanimité, mardi 20 octobre, un nouveau code pénal qui réintroduit la peine capitale… Plus » les 71 députés burkinabè ont adopté à l'unanimité, mardi 20 octobre, un nouveau code pénal qui réintroduit la peine capitale pour un certain nombre de crimes en lien avec le terrorisme, l'espionnage, la trahison ou encore l'importation de produits périmés ou prohibés susceptibles d'entraîner la mort.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso: The new Penal Code reintroduces the death penalty for certain offences
Burkina Faso.summary: The People's Legislative Assembly (Alp) unanimously adopted, on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, the draft law revising the Burkinabe Criminal Code. Defended by the Minister of Justice and Human Rights, Me Edasso Rodrigue Bayala, the text reintroduces the death penalty for certain offences, in particular those related to terrorism, espionage and treason . Meeting in plenary session, the 71 parliamentarians approved the draft law on the review of Law No.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso adopts a new penal code reinstating the death penalty
Burkina Faso.summary: The death penalty had been abolished in Burkina Faso in 2018 The deputies of the People's Legislative Assembly (Alp) of Burkina Faso adopted on Tuesday evening, unanimously by 71 voters, the draft law on the Penal Code which reinstates the death penalty for certain offences including acts of terrorism and espionage . According to the new penal code, acts of terrorism, espionage, treason, parricide and the importation of expired or prohibited products resulting in death are now punishable by death, explained the Minister of Justice, Edasso Rodrigue Bayala, after the vote .

Burkina Faso.title: « Le sentimentalisme, c’est fini » : au Burkina Faso, Ibrahim Traoré rétablit la peine de mort
Burkina Faso.summary: Huit ans après son abolition, la peine de mort a été réintroduite ce mardi dans le code pénal burkinabè. Un virage sécuritaire assumé par la junte au pouvoir, qui y voit un moyen de lutter contre le terrorisme et l’espionnage. Le Burkina Faso a réintroduit mardi la peine de mort dans un nouveau code pénal, après un vote à l’unanimité des membres non élus de l’Assemblée législative du peuple (ALP).

Burkina Faso.title: 66th anniversary of the National Armed Forces: a popular cross-country to kick off the festivities
Burkina Faso.summary: The National Armed Forces organized a popular cross, under the sign of cohesion, as part of the commemorative activities of their 66th anniversary, Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in Ouagadougou. As part of the commemoration of their 66th anniversary, the National Armed Forces (FAN) kicked off activities on Tuesday, October 20, 2026, in Ouagadougou On this occasion, a popular cross-country race was organized in the afternoon that mobilized elements of the Defense and Security Forces (FDS), paramilitary bodies and civilian populations.

Burkina Faso.title: Burkina Faso reinstates death penalty: Justice ministry
Burkina Faso.summary: Burkina Faso has reinstated the death penalty following a unanimous vote by the country’s unelected legislature, the Justice Ministry announced Tuesday. The new penal code reverses the abolition of capital punishment in 2018. Authorities say the move aims to strengthen public order, uphold national values and improve security.

Niger.title: Lieutenant General Said Chanegriha receives the Minister of National Defence of the Republic of Niger
Niger.summary: Lieutenant General Said Chanegriha, Minister Delegate to the Minister of National Defence and Chief of Staff of the People's National Army, receives on Wednesday the Minister of Defence of the Republic of Niger, Lieutenant General Salifou Modi.

Niger.title: Algeria Deploys Military to Bolster Sahel Security
Niger.summary: Algeria’s decision in August to deploy elements of its military to support Niger’s ruling junta was more than simply a policy shift: It showed that one of Africa’s strongest militaries is prepared to project its power in the name of maintaining stability in the Sahel, according to analysts. The day after the Aug. 29 mutiny by a group of Nigerien soldiers, Algeria dispatched four Sukhoi Su-30 fighter jets and an air-to-air refueling plane to Niger’s Air Base 101 in Niamey.
